detail.longDescription: Hi folks , I built CodeMany [1] - to run your actions on a Mac/Linux box that you own. Stop paying by the minute, as your agents scale. Own your infra, and let CodeMany manage it. Over the last year, we scaled our commits/month by 30x [2]. Over the coming year, I don't see that slowing down. Some highlights about CodeMany: - CodeMany is 3x faster than Github Actions. Benchmarks published [3]. - small Go daemon inside a native mac/linux app. - has brought my CI monthly bill down from $582 to <$5. - each job gets an isolated just-in-time (JIT) runner, recycled when done. - Manages multiple machines out-of-box. Setup is easy: install it, connect GitHub, select repos, and use runs-on: [self-hosted, codemany] in a workflow. Add Linux or macOS to pick one kind of machine. Cost: $20/mo for 2 machines and $10/mo for each extra, Mac or Linux, one subscription per GitHub account or org, after a 14-day trial, no card. Would love to hear what would you like to see in CodeMany? Arpit [1] CodeMany: https://codemany.com . [2] AI agents made my CI bill 5× bigger. So I built Codemany: https://codemany.com/articles/ai-coding-agents-ci-costs . [3] Benchmarks published nightly on Github: https://github.com/codemanyhq/bench
